Class InventoryViewImpl

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.inventory.impl.InventoryViewImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
InventoryView
public class InventoryViewImpl extends Object implements InventoryView
Default implementation of InventoryView that holds references to the view's ID, Bukkit inventory, context, and provider.

This is an immutable data holder created by InventoryProvider.createView(InventoryContext). It delegates refresh operations to its associated provider.

Usage: Typically created inside an InventoryProvider implementation:

@Override
public InventoryView createView(InventoryContext context) {
    Inventory inventory = Bukkit.createInventory(null, 54, title);
    return new InventoryViewImpl("my_menu", inventory, context, this);
}

    • setButton

      public void setButton(int slot, @NotNull @NotNull Button button)
      Description copied from interface: InventoryView
      Sets a view-specific button at the given slot.

      Buttons set on the view level take precedence over buttons defined in the provider's configuration. This allows for dynamic injection of buttons like pagination or close buttons.

      Specified by:
      setButton in interface InventoryView
      Parameters:
      slot - the inventory slot index (0-based)
      button - the button to set; must not be null
